title: Tech Trends 2023
notes: 'Deloitte’s 14th annual Tech Trends report'. Six trends, each written in Now / New / Next sections. Executive summary: the report notes what's happening now, highlights 'new technologies and approaches that stand to become the norm within 18 to 24 months, and project[s] where the trends could be headed next during the coming decade.' horizon carries that edition-level statement unless the chapter states its own. Quotes are the chapter strap-lines unless noted. Prologue and epilogue are not trends. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: Through the glass: Immersive internet for the enterprise
entries.quote: Technologies such as augmented and virtual reality are transforming the metaverse from specialized tech to enterprise tool—potentially paving the way to new business models.
entries.subject: Metaverse and immersive internet (AR/VR)
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; next: the coming decade (edition-level)
entries.note: Executive summary: 'Over the next few years, tangible, conversational, and virtual interfaces will likely continue to graduate from tech to toy to enterprise tool.' The chapter also cites third-party forecasts (US$800 billion metaverse market by 2024; 25% of consumers spending an hour a day in the metaverse by 2026); those are not Deloitte's claims and are not recorded as values.

entries.label: Opening up to AI: Learning to trust our AI colleagues
entries.quote: While the value of artificial intelligence is now undoubtable, the question has become how to best use it—and that often boils down to how much workers and end users trust AI tools.
entries.subject: Trustworthy AI
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; next: the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Above the clouds: Taming multicloud chaos
entries.quote: To simplify multicloud management, enterprises are beginning to turn to a layer of abstraction and automation that offers a single pane of control.
entries.subject: Multicloud management (metacloud, supercloud)
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; next: the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Flexibility, the best ability: Reimagining the tech workforce
entries.quote: Over the next 18–24 months, technology leaders can reimagine the workforce and workplace to focus on the skills (both human and technical)
entries.subject: Technology talent and workforce
entries.note: Same chapter: 'Over the next two years, the tech talent crunch may continue to impact the bottom line.'

entries.label: In us we trust: Decentralized architectures and ecosystems
entries.quote: In an environment of ever-increasing mistrust, blockchain and Web3 could power “trustless” systems that decentralize data to rebuild trust.
entries.subject: Blockchain and Web3 (decentralized trust)
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; next: the coming decade (edition-level)

entries.label: Connect and extend: Mainframe modernization hits its stride
entries.quote: Instead of completely replacing mainframe systems, businesses have begun looking for ways to extend the functionality of mainframe systems by linking them to emerging technologies.
entries.subject: Mainframe modernization
entries.horizon: within 18 to 24 months; next: the coming decade (edition-level)
